cases.rationale: Complete six-part specimen-level vectors, D5573-scoped classification, independent lots, observer receipt and plan/result linkage.
Baseline and candidate specimens are distinct but paired on exactly the same two independent lots.
Cohesive share is identical but adhesive/fiber-tear modes shift; the full vector does not establish equivalence.
An incomplete vector is not silently renormalized.
A closed composition cannot exceed unit sum.
Negative mode fractions are invalid even when the vector sums to one.
A category fraction cannot exceed one.
Every specimen must have a complete vector over the frozen category ontology.
An unknown category cannot replace an ontology member.
Category order must match the exact frozen ontology across every specimen.
Area fractions and specimen-count fractions cannot be pooled in the same composition.
The two cohorts must use the same frozen category ontology version.
An unregistered D5573 edition blocks classification admission.
A lap-shear strength method cannot substitute for a classification practice.
D5573 applicability outside the registered SMC FRP class is not assumed.
A classification practice cannot be relabeled as a measurement method.
D5573 classifies failure modes but does not judge their acceptability.
Repeated specimens from one lot do not meet the two independent-lot minimum.
Independent baseline and candidate cohorts cannot share a manufacturing cluster.
A paired design must preserve exact baseline/candidate cluster pair identity.
An unclassifiable specimen must be declared and cannot vanish from the cohort.
Every specimen classification must bind its image or source-artifact digest.
Classification evidence requires at least two distinct observer references under this fixture contract.
Unresolved observer disagreement cannot be hidden by the cohort-level average.
Observer reliability must be backed by a source-bound receipt.
A result below the preregistered observer-agreement threshold is not admitted.
Compositional margins and analysis method must be frozen before outcomes are available.
Structural zeros require an explicit preregistered method or handling policy.
A pseudocount cannot be supplied while the policy declares none.
Analysis output must reference the exact frozen plan digest.
The analysis result must bind the exact full-vector manifest.
One scalar distance cannot replace the full per-category uncertainty vector.
The result must use the preregistered alpha and confidence level.
A well-formed compositional study may legitimately fail its equivalence criterion.
Raw classification/image evidence must be bound by a valid digest.
A specimen cannot appear in both baseline and candidate cohorts.
Coupon count does not identify an independent manufacturing unit.
The actual candidate cohort does not meet the preregistered cluster minimum.
A specimen-count composition records one classified category per specimen; a fractional mix belongs to a different measurement basis.
